_doc: Rider skills, bought with skill points: startPoints plus pointsPerLevel for every rider level past 1 (XP from any mode). cost[i] is the price of level i+1. perLevel values are added once per level in SledSpec.deriveParams / Tricks.

skills.name: Throttle Control
skills.desc: Smoother power in deep snow: more lug bite and float, less bogging.

skills.name: Carving
skills.desc: Sharper turns and better sidehilling: more ski bite and steering lock.

skills.name: Air Control
skills.desc: Faster flips and spins, more control mid-air.

skills.name: Landing
skills.desc: Takes harder and more crooked landings, and keeps more speed when it does go wrong.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.desc: Rides moguls and rough snow without getting thrown about or slowed.

skills.name: Hauling
skills.desc: Handles cargo and trailers better: less weight penalty, steadier trailer.
